description: This source file defines utility functions for managing Amazon SQS streams within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically providing a method to delete all queues related to a given provider and cluster.

classes.name: SQSStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods related to Amazon SQS stream management.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedQueues
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes all SQS queues associated with a specified provider and cluster ID by using a queue mapper to retrieve queues and then deleting each queue.
